- Lumen Transit has launched real-time bus arrival alerts for all 42 routes, notifying riders via the free app when their bus is five, ten, or fifteen minutes away using live GPS data that updates every 20 seconds.  
- The update introduces service-change notices for detours and cancellations and a new accessibility feature that announces arrivals through screen readers for visually impaired passengers.  
- While alerts are available today, service-change notices will expand to all routes by the end of next month, with plans to add similar features to two light-rail lines in the spring.

* **Real-time arrival alerts:** Riders can now receive notifications for all 42 bus routes when a vehicle is five, ten, or fifteen minutes away, powered by live GPS data.
* **Enhanced rider features:** The update introduces service-change notices for detours and cancellations, as well as a new accessibility setting for screen reader compatibility.
* **Future expansions:** Service-change notices will roll out to all routes by the end of next month, with plans to add alerts to two light-rail lines in the spring.

**Account Team Readout: Corvane Dental Group**

**Client Objectives**
*   Restore new-patient bookings to Q1 levels by the end of Q2.
*   Optimize and fix the mobile booking flow prior to the Q3 expansion.
*   Launch a new referral program for existing patients.

**Key Risks**
*   **Revenue Risk:** $55K of planned revenue is at risk if the three new clinic openings are delayed.
*   **Stakeholder Skepticism:** The Director of Operations is wary of paid social due to past negative experiences.
*   **Data & Compliance:** Incomplete booking data exists for two clinics due to a system migration, and patient testimonials are currently not approved by legal.
*   **Timeline Pressure:** The March 14 steering review is approaching without measurable results yet shown.

**Recommended Next Steps**
1.  **Data Audit:** Reconcile missing booking data from the two clinics affected by the system migration.
2.  **Mobile UX Fix:** Prioritize the mobile booking flow to address the high 38% abandonment rate.
3.  **Performance Proof:** Develop a small-scale pilot or "quick win" to demonstrate measurable results before the March 14 review.

**How can I share my calendar with people outside of my organization?**
You can share a calendar with external users by generating a view-only link. This allows others to see the schedule without having edit access.

**What types of recurring tasks are available?**
Tasks can now be set to repeat on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis. You also have the option to set a custom schedule for your recurring items.

**Can I access my tasks when I don't have an internet connection?**
Yes, the mobile app features an offline mode that keeps your last 30 days of tasks accessible. Any changes made while offline will automatically sync once you reconnect to the internet.

**How do I export my project data?**
Projects can be exported directly from the project menu. You can choose to save your data as either a CSV or a PDF file.

**Why was I receiving duplicate notifications for edited tasks?**
We have fixed a bug that caused notifications to arrive twice when two people edited the same task simultaneously. You should now only receive a single notification for these actions.
